title_en: In the Courtroom (19/20): Mediating Over Unpaid Wages
note_en: Repeating a one-syllable verb with 了 in the middle (V了V) describes a brief action already done: 老板想了想 "the boss thought for a moment." Plain 老板想 would sound flat or unfinished; the doubled verb adds the sense of "a little, briefly," much like English "thought it over for a second." The same pattern gives 看了看 "took a look" and 笑了笑 "gave a little smile."
